environment_setting: Country B, City X, where firearm ownership is common, and licensed dealers operate under strict regulations to prevent illegal sales.
norm_base: Licensed dealers Sell or deliver firearms/ammunition to individuals under 18, or handguns to those under 21 Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: maximize profits while adhering to regulations

legitimate.legitimate_action: Verify the age and identity of all customers before selling firearms or ammunition
legitimate.benefits: Compliance with the law, avoids legal consequences, maintains business reputation
legitimate.costs: Time spent verifying documents, potential loss of impatient customers

illegal.illegal_action: Sell a handgun to a 20-year-old customer without verifying their age
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years if discovered, loss of license, damage to reputation

character_profile.name: Mike Thompson
character_profile.goal: purchase a handgun for personal use

legitimate.legitimate_action: Wait until turning 21 to legally purchase a handgun
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, ensures compliance with the law
legitimate.costs: Delay in obtaining the desired firearm

illegal.illegal_action: Attempt to persuade John Carter to sell a handgun despite being underage
illegal.benefits: Immediate acquisition of the desired firearm
illegal.costs: Potential legal trouble if discovered, fine or other penalties

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advise John Carter to strictly follow regulations and report any suspicious activity
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with the law, promotes safety in the community
legitimate.costs: Time spent monitoring and advising, potential conflict with customers

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore Mike Thompson's attempt to purchase a handgun underage and not intervene
illegal.costs: Moral compromise, potential legal consequences if discovered
